commitResults.messageTitle: Rename chatbot from Duke to Friday
Add a echo feature and personality to chatbot for user inputs
Add the ability to display a list of items inputted by user
Add skill for codex to check its work
Bug fix where user can unmark work when it was not marked
Add Events and integrate inheritance and polymorphism
Add exception handling and error testing
Allow user to delete task/event/to-do and error handling
Add validated task storage and round-trip regression tests
commitResults.messageBody:
Introduce a Storage class to read and write UTF-8 records for todos,
deadlines, and events, preserving completion status and escaping special
characters so task text survives a save/load cycle.

Create missing parent folders, validate records before returning loaded
tasks, and write snapshots through a temporary file to avoid replacing
an existing save with an incomplete write. Add task-field getters so
persistence does not depend on console display strings.

Add dependency-free storage tests for missing files, round trips,
malformed records, large lists, and failed saves. All five test groups
pass with Java 25.0.3.fx-zulu.

commitResults.messageTitle: Save Friday tasks automatically and verify restart behavior
commitResults.messageBody:
Load tasks at startup from the portable relative path data/friday.txt
and save after every addition, deletion, or completion-status change.
Replace the fixed task array with a list so larger saved lists load
without truncation or array-capacity failures.

Warn on read or write failures while keeping the console usable. Disable
saving after a failed load to protect existing data, and retry failed
writes on the next task-list change. Ignore local task data in Git and
document the storage format and recovery steps.

Run UI cases in isolated temporary directories and add restart, existing
save, special-character, corruption, and I/O-failure cases to the UI test
plan. All 23 UI cases pass with Java 25.0.3.fx-zulu. Additional live checks
confirm immediate saves, recovery after write failures, and persistence
after process termination.

commitResults.messageTitle: Record milestone commits and course-level publishing workflow
commitResults.messageBody:
Keep the user's standing preference to commit verified work at logical
milestones while leaving unrelated user edits out of those commits.

Document the explicit publishing procedure: merge each level branch
into master without fast-forwarding, tag the merge commit, and push
master, the retained level branch, and its tag to the fork. Continue
to require an explicit request before pushing.

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge branch-Level-7 into master to complete task persistence
commitResults.messageBody:
Bring in automatic saving and startup loading, validated task records,
protection for malformed or unreadable data, and isolated persistence
regression tests. Include the documented milestone commit workflow.

Use an explicit merge commit so the course checks can identify the
merged level branch and tag this completed milestone as Level-7.
The implementation passed 23 UI cases and five storage test groups
with Java 25.0.3.fx-zulu before merging.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add strict date-time parsing and readable date formatting
commitResults.messageBody:
Parse ISO dates, ISO dates with 24-hour times, and day-first dates with
HHmm times into LocalDateTime values. Treat date-only input as midnight
and accept the minute-precision ISO representation used by storage.

Use strict resolution so impossible dates and times are rejected, and
format dates with English month names regardless of the system locale.
Keep this behavior in a shared helper for consistent task handling.

Verify supported formats, leap days, malformed input, and display rules
with three passing date/time test groups on Java 25.0.3.fx-zulu.

commitResults.messageTitle: Store deadline and event dates as validated LocalDateTime values
commitResults.messageBody:
Replace free-form date fields with immutable LocalDateTime values and
format task dates using readable English month names. Reject invalid
calendar dates, invalid times, and events ending before they start
without adding tasks or terminating the command loop.

Persist minute-precision ISO date-times independently of the display
format. Continue to load older records with supported dates, and reject
ambiguous legacy date text without overwriting the original save file.
Document accepted formats, midnight behavior, and legacy-data recovery.

Update UI and storage fixtures to use real dates and add invalid-date,
leap-day, time-preservation, and legacy-file checks. All 28 UI cases,
four date/time test groups, and six storage test groups pass with
Java 25.0.3.fx-zulu.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add date-based lookup for deadlines and events
commitResults.messageBody:
Introduce on yyyy-MM-dd to find deadlines due on a date and events
whose inclusive calendar-date range contains it. Use polymorphic
occursOn methods so undated tasks are naturally excluded.

Keep original task numbers in filtered output so mark, unmark, and
delete still target the intended task. Include completed tasks, report
empty results, and reject invalid query dates without changing data.
Document inclusive event boundaries and the read-only query behavior.

All 31 UI cases, five date/time test groups, and six storage test groups
pass with Java 25.0.3.fx-zulu. A live-process check also confirms that
queries and rejected date inputs do not rewrite the save file.

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge branch-Level-8 into master to complete dates and times
commitResults.messageBody:
Bring in strict date/time parsing, LocalDateTime task fields, readable
date display, ISO persistence, and date-based deadline/event lookup.
Preserve invalid or ambiguous legacy saves instead of guessing dates.

Create an explicit merge commit for the Level-8 milestone and retain
the merged branch so the course checks can identify it. The branch
passed 31 UI cases, five date/time test groups, and six storage test
groups with Java 25.0.3.fx-zulu before merging.

commitResults.messageTitle: Require incremental level pushes and per-level README updates
commitResults.messageBody:
Record the standing workflow to develop each level in verified
increments, committing and pushing the level branch after each
meaningful milestone instead of waiting until the end of the level.

Require a root README summary for every level, relevant user-guide
updates, final verification, a no-fast-forward merge into master,
a lightweight level tag, and publication of both branches and the tag.

Add the missing Level 7 and Level 8 implementation summaries to the
README. Leave the user's unrelated ASCII-banner edit out of this commit.
Only documentation changes; validate the staged diff for whitespace.
